title: Governed Observation (payload)
description: The payload of one governed observation — the afferent nerve (PRD FR-14). The row itself rides the audit substrate's envelope (emitted via the REGION's own audit-envelope.sh into a per-actor JSONL segment; one writer per file, so appends are always local and merges always clean). This schema governs the payload the envelope carries.

outcome_id.description: MUST resolve against the region manifest's declared outcomes — an observation about an undeclared outcome is refused at the door.

evidence.description: file:line citations. An observation without evidence is an opinion.
